verdicts.concept: DATE criteria field types and formats
verdicts.claim: DATE criteria supports five date format types: ISODATE (ISO-8601 formatted date, default), EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS...

verdicts.concept: DATE criteria field types and formats
verdicts.claim: ISODATE is the default date format for DATE criteria in MongoDB Atlas Online Archive.
OBJECT_ID format extracts the embedded date component from MongoDB ObjectId for archival matching.
The date field used for archival criteria cannot be modified after the online archive is created.
MongoDB Atlas Online Archive calculates document age using the formula: current_date > dateField + expireAfterDays.
The bounds of 7 to 9215 days apply to dataExpirationRule.expireAfterDays, not to criteria.expireAfterDays.

verdicts.concept: Partition fields constraints for DATE rules
verdicts.claim: When using DATE criteria, a maximum of three partition fields are allowed: the date field plus up to two additional commonly-queried fields.

verdicts.concept: Partition fields constraints for DATE rules
verdicts.claim: Partition field values are limited to a maximum of 700 characters; documents with partition field values exceeding this limit are not archived.
DATE criteria selects a single date field and an age in days; only the age parameter can be modified after archive creation, not the chosen date field.
Custom Criteria accepts standard MongoDB query filter expressions to define archival conditions.
